title: Kubernetes v1.37：持续演进下的云原生平台信号
english: Kubernetes v1.37, named “Garhwal,” introduces new Stable, Beta, and Alpha features while maintaining the project’s established release process. The release includes 67 enhancements: 16 graduated to Stable, 23 graduated to Beta, 27 entered Alpha, and one involved a deprecation or removal. For senior operations and platform engineers, the release is a signal to track feature maturity rather than treating every addition as production-ready. The different graduation stages provide a framework for evaluating adoption, testing operational impact, and planning platform upgrades. The release also reflects continued community support and a consistent development cycle, both of which are relevant when assessing Kubernetes as a foundation for cloud-native infrastructure and AI workloads.
chinese: Kubernetes v1.37“Garhwal”引入了新的 Stable、Beta 和 Alpha 功能，共包含 67 项增强：16 项升级为 Stable，23 项升级为 Beta，27 项进入 Alpha，另有 1 项涉及弃用或移除。对资深运维开发而言，重点不是简单追逐新功能，而是依据功能成熟度评估生产采用、测试范围和升级计划。不同阶段为平台工程团队提供了清晰的风险判断依据，也说明 Kubernetes 仍在通过持续发布和社区协作推进云原生基础设施演进。
why_it_matters: Kubernetes 是云原生平台和 AI 工作负载基础设施的重要组成部分。Stable、Beta、Alpha 的成熟度分层有助于 AIOps 或 Agent Infra 团队制定功能准入、变更验证和生产升级策略；能够结合版本成熟度分析平台风险，也是资深平台工程师和运维开发岗位的重要能力。
interview_expression: I assess Kubernetes changes by their maturity stage and operational impact before introducing them into production. This helps the platform team balance access to new capabilities with upgrade and reliability risks.

vocabulary.example: We evaluate feature maturity before adopting a new Kubernetes capability in production.
Several enhancements graduated to Stable in the latest Kubernetes release.
The team needs to review the deprecation before planning the platform upgrade.
